resources.string: अभी क्या चल रहा है (Running Now Live)
Shows all currently running Panchanga limbs, Muhurtas, Choghadiya, Hora, Tattva, and Swara Nadi live on your Home Screen.
होरा, पंच-तत्व व स्वर नाड़ी लाइव (Hora, Tattva & Swara)
Live Planetary Hora, 5-Sub-Tattva window, Flowing Swara Nadi (Ida/Pingala), and Celestial/Tithi/Nakshatra Swara windows.
शुभ मुहूर्त व चौघड़िया लाइव (Muhurta & Choghadiya)
Live running Auspicious/Inauspicious Muhurtas (Abhijit, Rahu Kala, Brahma, Amrita), active Choghadiya, and Sunrise/Sunset.
रनिंग नाउ लाइव पट्टी (Running Now Strip)
Sleek semi-transparent glass strip showing live Hora, Sub-Tattva, Swara Nadi, Tithi, and active Muhurta with live countdowns.
Sunrise, Sunset, Tithi transitions, and Vrat observance reminders.
Opt-in permanent high-priority notification displaying live Hora, Tattva, Nadi, and Tithi.
